title: Sirhan Sirhan's diary before the RFK shooting

tellings.quote: who had written in his diary right before he shot RFK,

plain: Sirhan Sirhan, the man who shot the politician Robert F. Kennedy, known as RFK, in Los Angeles in 1968, is said to have written in his diary just before the shooting. Michels mentions the diary himself, in an episode about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council, though in the words given he does not say what was written in it.
